Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner inaccurately asserted that Captain James Cook named the Bering Strait and inferred that the Bering Sea (the body of water where St. Matthew Island is located) was therefore named after Cook. This is incorrect—both the Bering Strait and Bering Sea are named after Vitus Bering. The error stems from misinterpretation of the naming origin and faulty inference, leading toward an incorrect solution.
